## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`, not `main`
- [ ] Full suite passes locally and CI is green
- [ ] Docs changed with behaviour (PRD, acceptance matrix, `docs/architecture.md`)
- [ ] UI changes checked against `docs/ui-quality.md`
- [ ] Copy and PR text passed through the `unslop` skill
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased
- [ ] Not merged: only the owner merges
